text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador, Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To help revitalize Tomakomai,
I have to win lots of races and get famous...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I'll give it my all with a passion as hot as Mount Tarumae's lava! I look forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
